snippet.title: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire - Release Date Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Step into the stylish noir world of Mouseburg in MOUSE: P.I. For Hire. You’re Jack Pepper, a former war-hero turned private investigator in a gritty city where the smallest mouse hole hides the biggest secrets.

This black-and-white first-person shooter fuses hand-drawn rubber-hose animation inspired by 1930s cartoons with high-octane gunplay. Explore film studios, seedy alleys, swamps and sewers. Fury meets fun as you wield tommy-guns, fire up experimental weapons and unravel a web of corruption, murder and conspiracy.  ￼

Launch date: 19 March 2026. Wishlist it now
